title: PickerStep
description: Overrides for the picker step. Each field replaces the page's default as a whole.

sites.description: The suggested sites, in display order. The page groups them by section. Every id needs a bundled icon and translated copy, so a new site still needs a page release.

id.description: Stable key for the site's copy, its bundled icon and the addFavorites message

url.description: The URL saved as the favorite when neither urlByRegion nor urlTemplate gives one

urlByRegion.description: URLs to save instead of url, keyed by the OS region native sends as init.region, as an upper-case ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code. Checked before urlTemplate.

urlTemplate.description: A URL with a {locale} placeholder, for a site whose URLs follow the language. The page fills it with its two-letter lower-case language code. It's used when urlByRegion has no match, and skipped when the locale isn't a two-letter code.

title.description: The site's name, shown on its tile and used as the favorite's title

section.description: The group the tile appears in

existingFavorites.description: URLs of the favorites the user already has, filled in from the shouldShowTopSitesPicker answer. Never more than 4, because native answers no at 5 or more. A suggested site matches a favorite when their hostnames match after dropping a leading "www.". A site whose URL has a path, such as https://www.bbc.com/news, also needs the favorite's path to be that path or a path below it. The page shows matching sites as picked and locked, and leaves them out of addFavorites. Unparseable URLs are skipped.
